name: Divano

attributes.attribute: identified by the Romans with Mars

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Divano was a god of the continental Celts, though records of him are few. The Romans identified this obscure god with their warrior divinity Mars. He never gained a wide cult among the Celtic peoples.
objective: Record the obscure Continental Celtic god Divano and his equation with Mars.
key_results: Divano was identified by the Romans with Mars
He remained an obscure continental god
evidence: Monaghan, The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
